questions.question: Add an actual cover image for the Mathematicians Joke card. The current package contains no image.

localizations.source: Add an actual cover image for the Mathematicians Joke card. The current package contains no image.
localizations.ru: Добавить фактическую обложку для карточки материала в рубрике «Математики шутят». Сейчас в пакете нет изображения.

questions.question: Provide the public URL and date of the original publication and confirm Mansur Gilmullin’s original authorship, or present the material as an anonymous adaptation with a legal basis.

localizations.source: Provide the public URL and date of the original publication and confirm Mansur Gilmullin’s original authorship, or present the material as an anonymous adaptation with a legal basis.
